ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.
   D. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
   C. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.
   D. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

15. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   B. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Selected verses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in revealed scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Ulul-Azm Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
